## Same Day & Next Day Auto Glass Repair
* Fast & Reliable
  
  With 30+ years in the auto glass industry, we will get you back on the road in no time.
* Price Match Guarantee
  
  Our Price Match Guarantee ensures you get the best price for your auto glass service.
* Insurance Accepted
  
  We take all insurance. Plus, we manage your insurance claim.
* Lifetime Warranty
  
  No-hassle warranty against glass defects or repairs needed to our original work. 

[
[Buy Now Pay Later for Windshield Repair/Replacement]
[Buy Now Pay Later for Windshield Repair & Replacement]

## Our Customers Say
* This company is awesome. They were kind, understanding, professional and did an amazing job. If
  you need your windshield replaced or repaired this is the place to go.
  Rhonda W.
* I was able to schedule service same day and everyone was super polite and thorough. Price was far
  lower than other local options, and includes a lifetime warranty.
  Emily B.
* Amazing experience! Quick, affordable, and the man that worked at the front so kind, even gave my
  children snacks as we were waiting and put on a show for them!
  Helena P.
* I am very happy with the service I received at Auto Glass Now. Everyone was very nice and the
  windshield install was done in a timely manner. A+
  Bonnie S.
* Absolutely the best! This is the second time I have used this company and they are fast and price
  is competitive. They will price match!!! Will use them again!!!
  Diane T.
* Fantastic customer service and very quick service! I didn't have an appointment but they fixed my
  cracked windshield right away. I would recommend this business to anyone...
  Kimberly M.
* 11/10 experience. I had to get my back rear glass replaced and Auto Glass got me in the very next
  day and replaced it for a great price. The workers there were amazing too!
  Chantal R.

IT’S EASY!

#### recalibration (VGRRR). Our 30,000 colleagues are at the heart of our business and provide an
#### outstanding service to millions of customers around the world. Our Belron global family of
#### businesses is made up of major brands operating in 42 markets around the world. We are united
#### in our purpose – to make a memorable difference with care to our customers, our people, society
#### and our shareholders.**

  ### Laser^{®}
  
  Laser® provides plumbing and electrical solutions to home and business owners across Australia and

# Making a *memorable difference* with care

#### **We’re proud to be one of the world’s leaders in vehicle glass repair, replacement and
#### recalibration (VGRRR). Our 30,000 colleagues are at the heart of our business and provide an
#### outstanding service to millions of customers around the world. Our Belron global family of
#### businesses is made up of major brands operating in 42 markets around the world. We are united
#### in our purpose – to make a memorable difference with care to our customers, our people, society
#### and our shareholders.**

[Customer video]

# World-class care *for customers*

We are one of the world-leaders in vehicle glass repair, replacement and recalibration - with
unrivalled customer satisfaction. 

[What we do][45]
[Colleague video]

# World-class care *for colleagues*

Driven, caring, collaborative and genuine people are at the heart of Belron.

[How we work][46]
[Communities thumbnail ]

# World-class care *for communities*

Recognising the positive impact business can have, by supporting local initiatives and global
charitable causes. 

[Giving back][47]
[Recycling]

# World-class care *for climate*

Continually striving towards being a truly sustainable and ethical business. 

[Doing business responsibly ][48]

# The Belron *family*
* [Autoglass]
  
  ### Autoglass^{®}
  
  Autoglass^{®} is one of the UK and Ireland's leading vehicle glass repair and replacement company,
  serving more than one million motorists each year. 
* [Carglass]
  
  ### Carglass^{®}
  
  Carglass^{®} is the leading vehicle glass repair and replacement company operating across 28
  countries in Europe, Africa and Asia. 
* [Le beau new ]
  
  ### Lebeau^{®} Vitres d'autos
  
  Lebeau^{®} Vitres d'autos^{ }is Quebec's leading vehicle glass repair and replacement company. 
* [Obrien]
  
  ### O'Brien^{®}
  
  Recognised market leader O'Brien^{®} offers a professional glass repair and replacement service
  across Australia. 
* [Safelite logo]
  
  ### Safelite^{®}
  
  Safelite^{®} is the largest vehicle glass specialist company in the United States, with more than
  720 locations nationwide. 
* [Smith&Smith]
  
  ### Smith&Smith^{®}
  
  Smith&Smith^{®} is New Zealand's leading vehicle glass repair and replacement company. 
* [Laddaw]
  
  ### Laddaw^{®}
  
  Laddaw^{®} is the UK distribution centre for vehicle replacement glass and other associated
  products. 
* [Origlass]
  
  ### Origlass^{®}
  
  Origlass^{®} is the number one distributor of automotive glass in Italy providing a wide range of
  products to thousands of dealers. 
* [Hurtigruta]
  
  ### Hurtigruta Carglass^{®}
  
  Hurtigruta Carglass^{®} delivers first-class vehicle glass service across Norway, serving more
  than 60,000 customers each year. 
* [Speedy glass]
  
  ### Speedy^{®} Glass
  
  Speedy^{®} Glass is Canada's leading vehicle glass repair and replacement company, serving over
  300,000 customers each year. 
* [Autoglass specials ]
  
  ### Autoglass^{®} Specials
  
  Autoglass^{®} Specials offers a specialist glazing repair and replacement service to coach, bus,
  PCV (PSV) and rail operators throughout the UK.
* [Vanfax]
  
  ### Vanfax^{®}
  
  Vanfax^{®} is one of Canada's largest distributors of vehicle glass, delivering across Canada,
  from Vancouver to Halifax. 
* [Laser]
  
  ### Laser^{®}
  
  Laser® provides plumbing and electrical solutions to home and business owners across Australia and
  New Zealand,

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

# Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS)

Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS) is India’s leading integrated glass and window solutions company and a
dominant player both in the automotive and the building & construction segments. Our product
solutions spanning the entire breadth of automotive, building & construction, and consumer glass,
are designed to deliver aesthetics and functional benefits.

## [AUTOMOTIVE][43]

AIS is the preferred choice of leading transport players as well as consumers of automotive glass
products. We are specialists in creating innovative glass solutions for anything that moves on
wheels, rails, water or air. Our glass solutions in the category span the entire breadth of
passenger vehicles from mass modes of transportation (buses and trains) to ships and yachts. Our
glasses are also used in defence vehicles.

## [BUILDING AND CONSTRUCTION][44]

AIS is a transformation leader in the world of architectural glass products and services. Our
architectural portfolio includes various glass solutions for exterior and interior architecture. Be
it residential or commercial projects, our premium glass solutions can be customised to optimally
suit individual design sensibilities. From privacy to safety, from thermal comfort to acoustic
insulation, our glass solutions offer the right blend of aesthetics and functionality.

## [CONSUMER ][45]

AIS caters to the modern consumer’s needs with its varied products and services under different
Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and brands. Depending upon individual needs, our customised
offerings extend from windshield repair and replacement to premium car-care services for the
automotive segment. For the windows and doors segment in residential spaces, we offer bespoke
offerings and 360-degree glass and frame solutions, specially built for institutional businesses and
homeowners, alike.

## [INDUSTRIAL ][46]

AIS is a well-known brand in the arena of industrial glass. It offers an exclusive range of glass
solutions, specifically designed for the unique needs of industries dealing in consumer durables,
commercial refrigeration, dynamic glazing and material handling vehicles. The technical, aesthetic,
energy and safety performance of our premium glass solutions make their scope of applications
practically unlimited for the industrial segment.

## ABOUT AIS

AIS is India’s leading integrated glass and windows solutions company. It provides end-to-end
solutions to the customers right from manufacturing, processing, fabrication and installation. It is
a sand-to-solutions organization offering varied glass products and solutions for the industrial as
well as end customers in the domestic and international markets. AIS strictly adheres to the
stringent quality norms of both the global and domestic OEMs and follows all Indian and
International quality standards.

CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY
AIS believes that the future rests in the inclusive progress of all, and it has thus, developed a
strong Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) framework for the welfare and upliftment of the
communities around its manufacturing facilities.

# Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS)

Asahi India Glass Ltd (AIS) is India’s leading integrated glass and window solutions company and a
dominant player both in the automotive and the building & construction segments. Our product
solutions spanning the entire breadth of automotive, building & construction, and consumer glass,
are designed to deliver aesthetics and functional benefits.

## [AUTOMOTIVE][43]

AIS is the preferred choice of leading transport players as well as consumers of automotive glass
products. We are specialists in creating innovative glass solutions for anything that moves on
wheels, rails, water or air. Our glass solutions in the category span the entire breadth of
passenger vehicles from mass modes of transportation (buses and trains) to ships and yachts. Our
glasses are also used in defence vehicles.

## [BUILDING AND CONSTRUCTION][44]

AIS is a transformation leader in the world of architectural glass products and services. Our
architectural portfolio includes various glass solutions for exterior and interior architecture. Be
it residential or commercial projects, our premium glass solutions can be customised to optimally
suit individual design sensibilities. From privacy to safety, from thermal comfort to acoustic
insulation, our glass solutions offer the right blend of aesthetics and functionality.

## [CONSUMER ][45]

AIS caters to the modern consumer’s needs with its varied products and services under different
Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and brands. Depending upon individual needs, our customised
offerings extend from windshield repair and replacement to premium car-care services for the
automotive segment. For the windows and doors segment in residential spaces, we offer bespoke
offerings and 360-degree glass and frame solutions, specially built for institutional businesses and
homeowners, alike.

## [INDUSTRIAL ][46]

AIS is a well-known brand in the arena of industrial glass. It offers an exclusive range of glass
solutions, specifically designed for the unique needs of industries dealing in consumer durables,
commercial refrigeration, dynamic glazing and material handling vehicles. The technical, aesthetic,
energy and safety performance of our premium glass solutions make their scope of applications
practically unlimited for the industrial segment.

# Auto Glass Madness

Auto Glass Madness is an auto glass shop in Winter Park, Florida, focused on getting drivers safely
back on the road.
[📞 Call (689) 290-0342][5]

## Auto glass service in Winter Park, FL

Whether it's a delivery van or a family SUV, Winter Park drivers count on clear, properly sealed
glass for safe visibility. Modern vehicles often need ADAS camera recalibration after a windshield
change so driver-assist features aim correctly.

## Services offered

Common automotive glass services handled by shops like Auto Glass Madness.

◈

### Windshield Replacement

Full windshield removal and replacement using OEM-quality glass and proper urethane cure times.

◆

### Windshield Chip & Crack Repair

Fast resin repair for rock chips and small cracks before they spread across the glass.

▧

### Auto Glass Replacement

Replacement of any damaged automotive glass, sealed and fitted to factory specification.

▤

### Side & Door Glass

Door, quarter, and vent glass replacement for cars, trucks, and SUVs.

◧

### Rear & Back Glass

Rear windshield and back glass replacement, including defroster grid reconnection.

▣

### Power Window Repair

Window regulator and motor repair to get stuck or off-track windows moving again.

◐

### ADAS Calibration

Recalibration of forward-facing cameras and driver-assist sensors after glass work.

☗

### Mobile Auto Glass Service

On-site glass service at home or work, wherever the vehicle is parked.

✦

### Insurance Claim Assistance

Help filing and processing auto glass insurance claims from start to finish.

# Automotive Glass Experts (AGE)

Automotive Glass Experts (AGE) is a distinguished consortium of specialists in the field of
automotive glass services. With over 15 years of experience, they have built a solid reputation as a
trusted reference in the industry.

Operating in 26 countries across Europe, North America, Asia,
and Africa, AGE has established a robust global network. This expansive reach allows them to provide
high-quality services across borders through collaborative partnerships within their network.

[ Learn More ][31]


## Main Services

Our automotive glass services are delivered by a unique network of AGE member companies that offer
customized solutions to meet all your needs.

[ [automotive glass repair] ][32]

[ Glass Repair ][33]

Our team of specialist glass professionals approaches every repair with precision and expertise,
prioritizing safety and quality above all else. Furthermore, our repairs strictly adhere to the
rigorous standards set forth by the BSI, ensuring reliability and excellence in every service we
offer.

[Know more][34]

[ Glass Replacement ][35]

We only use replacement glass from the leading manufacturers for both OEM market and aftermarket and
use the highest quality adhesive from the world’s number one chemical company.

[Know more][36]
[ [ADAS Calibration in AGE workstations] ][37]

[ ADAS Recalibration ][38]

Windshield mounted cameras are key to the function of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS).
These cameras require recalibration following a windshield replacement in order to ensure the
vehicle’s safety systems continue to work as intended.

[Know more][39]
[ [National Windscreens - AGE member in United Kingdom] ][40]

[ Mobile Service ][41]

Our glass professionals will come to you, wherever you are, to deliver quality automotive glass
services.

[Know more][42]

# How Glass Speaks to Light^{™}

From the White House to the Burj Khalifa, from the U.S. to Sweden, Germany, and countries all
throughout the world, our glass plays an integral part in some of the most recognizable structures
ever built.

[ Explore projects ][166]

### Bendheim Glass Systems

Precision-engineered, proven, and easy to specify, our wide range of interior and exterior glass
systems offer flexibility and ease of installation for a variety of applications.

## Visions Realized

You share your ideas and imagination. Together, with the help of our collaborative Design-Assist
process, we turn visions into reality… without compromise. Our only limitations are the laws of
physics.

1

### Design Assist & System Development

To support the design process, early collaboration and visualization help identify potential
challenges, optimize system details, and align design intent with project budgets.

2

### Design Assist & System Development

Provides access to specialized glass knowledge and systems, feasibility, and structural
considerations. Streamline fabrication, reduce costs, and enhance sustainability.

3

### Unique Facades

Create complex facade geometries on tighter budgets, add texture & depth to the facade.

4

### Ease of Installation

No holes through the glass. Compression fittings easily adjust to field conditions speeding the
construction schedule.

5

### Vision Through Custom Solutions

Bendheim’s ventilated glass facade systems protect structures and/or occupants from wind-driven
rain, snow, and ice, while maintaining natural ventilation and daylight advantages.

6

### Visions Realized

Our engineered glass systems provide safety with durable materials, while ensuring ease of
installation through innovative design. They offer aesthetic flexibility, are cost-effective, and
sustainable.

### Welcome to Capital Car glass

The majority of our products are sourced direct from European manufacturers, but we also source
products from around the world. We work closely with both the OE manufacturers and after-market
replacement factories

### Our Services

To deal directly with us and create an account, simply fill out the contact or give us a call. Our
team will be happy assist you with any inquiries or requests you may have. We pride ourselves on
providing excellent customer service and high-quality glass fitting services.

[WhatsApp Image 2022-07-11 at 4.18.55 PM (4).jpeg]

Capital Car Glass have been in the vehicle glass repair and replacement industry for more than 18

glass shop that stocks and carries more than 100 different models of Genuine glass parts to ensure
that our customers' interest and needs are taken care of.

 

With our company's vision close to heart, we continue to constantly improve and upgrade ourselves so
to achieve our vision of becoming a comprehensive car glass solution provider that sets new safety,
quality and service standards.

 

At Capital Car Glass, we strongly believe that we can become a company you can rely on for all your
vehicle glass needs.

#### [
#### 1. What is safety glass and why is it important?
#### ][44]

Safety glass is a type of glass made to reduce injuries if the glass breaks. Normal glass can
shatter into sharp pieces, which can be dangerous. Safety glass, however, is designed to be stronger
and to break in a safer way. Because of this, it is commonly used in vehicles, buildings, and public
transport systems.

A professional safety glass manufacturer in India produces glass that can handle pressure,
vibration, and sudden impact. This is especially important for vehicles like buses and trucks that
operate on different kinds of roads every day.

There are two main types of safety glass used in the industry.

One of them is laminated glass. This glass has a plastic layer placed between two sheets of glass.
If it cracks or breaks, the pieces usually stick to that plastic layer instead of scattering
everywhere. For this reason, a bus windshield manufacturer in India generally uses laminated glass
for vehicle windshields.

The other type is tempered glass. It becomes stronger through a special heating and cooling process.
A trusted bus glass manufacturer in India often uses tempered glass for side windows and other
vehicle glass components.

Safety glass is also important in modern construction. As an experienced architectural glass
manufacturer in India, companies like Duratuf Glass supply glass that improves safety, durability,
and building performance.

2. What is laminated glass used for?[Anil Kumar][45]2026-03-07T06:13:31+00:00

#### [
#### 2. What is laminated glass used for?
#### ][46]

Laminated glass is a type of safety glass made by joining two glass layers with a plastic layer in
the middle. This middle layer helps hold the glass together if it breaks. Because of this feature,
laminated glass is widely used in both vehicles and buildings.

A leading automotive glass manufacturer in India produces laminated glass mainly for vehicle
windshields. Windshields must be strong because they protect drivers and passengers from wind, dust,
and possible road accidents. Laminated glass helps reduce injuries because it does not shatter
easily.

A reliable bus windshield manufacturer in India uses laminated glass in buses and coaches to improve
passenger safety. It also helps drivers maintain better visibility in different weather conditions.

3. What does an automotive glass manufacturer in India do?[Anil Kumar][47]2026-03-07T06:13:25+00:00

#### [
#### 3. What does an automotive glass manufacturer in India do?
#### ][48]

An automotive glass manufacturer in India focuses on producing glass designed specifically for
vehicles. This includes buses, trucks, cars, and other transportation vehicles. Vehicle glass needs
to be stronger than ordinary glass because it must protect drivers and passengers during travel.

These manufacturers produce different types of vehicle glass, such as windshields, side window
glass, and other safety glass components. A trusted bus glass manufacturer in India supplies glass
that is used in buses, coaches, and public transport vehicles.

They also work with companies that manufacture trucks and other commercial vehicles. As a reliable
commercial vehicle glass manufacturer, companies like Duratuf Glass supply glass that can handle
rough road conditions and long-distance travel.

Vehicle glass must also meet strict safety standards. A dependable vehicle safety glass manufacturer
in India tests the glass carefully to ensure it can withstand impact, pressure, and temperature
changes.

By using advanced manufacturing technology, automotive glass manufacturers help improve the safety
and reliability of vehicles used every day.

4. What industries use commercial and architectural glass?[Anil Kumar][49]2026-03-07T06:13:20+00:00

#### [
#### 4. What industries use commercial and architectural glass?
#### ][50]

Commercial and architectural glass is used in several industries, especially in construction and
infrastructure development. A trusted architectural glass manufacturer in India produces glass that
is widely used in modern buildings, offices, and commercial complexes.

Glass is commonly used in windows, facades, curtain walls, and skylights. It allows natural light to
enter buildings while also improving the appearance of the structure. As a reliable commercial glass
manufacturer in India, Duratuf Glass supplies glass for many types of construction projects.

Large public infrastructure projects also rely on strong glass. A professional glass manufacturing
company in India often supplies glass for railway stations, airports, shopping malls, and hotels
where durability is important.

Glass is not limited to buildings. Manufacturers also supply glass for vehicles. A leading
automotive glass manufacturer in India produces safety glass used in buses, trucks, and other
transport vehicles.

Because of its strength, transparency, and design benefits, architectural and commercial glass has
become an essential material in modern construction.

5. How do glass manufacturers make strong and safe glass?[Anil Kumar][51]2026-03-07T06:12:32+00:00

#### [
#### 5. How do glass manufacturers make strong and safe glass?
#### ][52]

Glass manufacturers follow several steps to produce strong and safe glass. A professional glass
manufacturing company in India uses specialized machines and strict quality checks to make sure the
glass meets industry standards.

The process usually begins with melting raw materials at very high temperatures to form glass
sheets. After that, the glass is processed based on how it will be used. For example, an automotive
glazing manufacturer in India produces laminated glass and tempered glass for vehicles.

Laminated glass is made by placing a strong plastic layer between two sheets of glass. This is why a
bus windshield manufacturer in India often uses laminated glass for vehicle windshields.

Tempered glass is produced by heating the glass and then cooling it quickly. This process increases
the strength of the glass significantly. A trusted vehicle safety glass manufacturer in India
commonly uses this method to produce glass for vehicle side windows.

Before the glass reaches the market, manufacturers also test it for durability and strength. A
reliable commercial vehicle glass manufacturer checks whether the glass can handle pressure, impact,
and temperature changes.

These processes ensure the glass is safe for use in vehicles as well as modern buildings.

facades, and skylights in modern buildings.

Because it offers both strength and safety, laminated glass has become a common choice in the
transportation and construction industries.

3. What does an automotive glass manufacturer in India do?[Anil Kumar][47]2026-03-07T06:13:25+00:00

#### [
#### 3. What does an automotive glass manufacturer in India do?
#### ][48]

An automotive glass manufacturer in India focuses on producing glass designed specifically for
vehicles. This includes buses, trucks, cars, and other transportation vehicles. Vehicle glass needs
to be stronger than ordinary glass because it must protect drivers and passengers during travel.

These manufacturers produce different types of vehicle glass, such as windshields, side window
glass, and other safety glass components. A trusted bus glass manufacturer in India supplies glass
that is used in buses, coaches, and public transport vehicles.

They also work with companies that manufacture trucks and other commercial vehicles. As a reliable
commercial vehicle glass manufacturer, companies like Duratuf Glass supply glass that can handle
rough road conditions and long-distance travel.

Vehicle glass must also meet strict safety standards. A dependable vehicle safety glass manufacturer
in India tests the glass carefully to ensure it can withstand impact, pressure, and temperature
changes.

By using advanced manufacturing technology, automotive glass manufacturers help improve the safety
and reliability of vehicles used every day.

4. What industries use commercial and architectural glass?[Anil Kumar][49]2026-03-07T06:13:20+00:00

#### [
#### 4. What industries use commercial and architectural glass?
#### ][50]

Commercial and architectural glass is used in several industries, especially in construction and
infrastructure development. A trusted architectural glass manufacturer in India produces glass that
is widely used in modern buildings, offices, and commercial complexes.

Glass is commonly used in windows, facades, curtain walls, and skylights. It allows natural light to
enter buildings while also improving the appearance of the structure. As a reliable commercial glass
manufacturer in India, Duratuf Glass supplies glass for many types of construction projects.

Large public infrastructure projects also rely on strong glass. A professional glass manufacturing
company in India often supplies glass for railway stations, airports, shopping malls, and hotels
where durability is important.

Glass is not limited to buildings. Manufacturers also supply glass for vehicles. A leading
automotive glass manufacturer in India produces safety glass used in buses, trucks, and other
transport vehicles.

Because of its strength, transparency, and design benefits, architectural and commercial glass has
become an essential material in modern construction.

5. How do glass manufacturers make strong and safe glass?[Anil Kumar][51]2026-03-07T06:12:32+00:00

#### [
#### 5. How do glass manufacturers make strong and safe glass?
#### ][52]

Glass manufacturers follow several steps to produce strong and safe glass. A professional glass
manufacturing company in India uses specialized machines and strict quality checks to make sure the
glass meets industry standards.

The process usually begins with melting raw materials at very high temperatures to form glass
sheets. After that, the glass is processed based on how it will be used. For example, an automotive
glazing manufacturer in India produces laminated glass and tempered glass for vehicles.

Laminated glass is made by placing a strong plastic layer between two sheets of glass. This is why a
bus windshield manufacturer in India often uses laminated glass for vehicle windshields.

Tempered glass is produced by heating the glass and then cooling it quickly. This process increases
the strength of the glass significantly. A trusted vehicle safety glass manufacturer in India
commonly uses this method to produce glass for vehicle side windows.

Before the glass reaches the market, manufacturers also test it for durability and strength. A
reliable commercial vehicle glass manufacturer checks whether the glass can handle pressure, impact,
and temperature changes.

These processes ensure the glass is safe for use in vehicles as well as modern buildings.

professional engineers are experienced with application of codes and standards while providing value

and efficient completion of complex value added client focused designs. Perigon often supports
pre-project planning with preliminary engineering and Total Installed Cost estimates to support
client planning and capital appropriation.

# [[Total Glass Services]][6]
* [Home][7]
* [Contact][8]
* [San Jose][9]
* [Salinas][10]

TGI is an independent and family run automotive glass distributor located in San Jose, California,
and has been in business for over 40 years. We carry a variety of automotive glass from popular
numbers to obsolete and rare items, as well as regular aftermarket and original equipment brands.

Customer service is at the heart of our business and our enthusiastic staff is always available to
look up parts, list prices, and labor hours. We offer additional help over the phone, providing an
overall pleasant experience for our customers and complimentary VIN number look up as well. Our
average turnaround time for our will call customers is the fastest in the greater Bay Area.

TGI is a one stop shop! In addition to automotive glass, we sell installation accessories like
urethane, primers, and moldings, as well as various installation tools. Thank you for visiting our
website, we look forward to doing business with you in the near future.

consultants, and trade partners with fully compliant and easily customisable solutions. We bring our
safety and security expertise to every building project to ensure the delivery of safe, comfortable,
and sustainable construction.

## About Windshield Store®

Brief company history

Windshield Store® is ISO 9001:2015 certified automotive glass replacement and windshield repair
service brand. Windshield store®, formerly Auto Glass Masters, is owned by Unified Corporation Pvt
Ltd and operates in Delhi, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Mumbai.

Windshield Store® operates 10+ service centers at prominent locations in Greater Kailash, Naraina,
Narela, Sector 54 Gurgaon, Sheetla Mata Road, Sector 116 Noida, NIT Faridabad, Badarpur Border,
Jaipur,Udaipur and Saki-Naka Andheri, Mumbai. These stores are supported by customized vans which
help us to offer doorstep replacement of your car windshield.

At Windshield Store® we have a centralized procurement system for car glass, bus glass, adhesives,
and accessories to ensure quality products across all service centers. All glasses are directly
procured from the OEM glass manufacturers or their authorized dealers in the case of luxury car
glasses.

The Windshield Store® prides itself on its quality workmanship, fast and efficient service, and
exceptional customer care. Our team of experienced and certified technicians uses the latest tools
and techniques to ensure that every job is completed to the highest standards.

Windshield Store® is committed to providing its customers with a hassle-free and convenient
experience. We offer doorstep mobile service, where our technicians can come to the customer’s
location to carry out the replacements. We also provide a one-year warranty on all our services,
giving customers the peace of mind they need while driving.

### Repair First Policy

As per our company policy, we don’t believe in replacement as the first option. If the crack in your
car’s front glass is smaller than 3 inches, our team of windshield repair experts would suggest you
go for a repair. In case the crack is not repairable, we have options for windshield replacement.

Windshield Store® employs automotive experts with years of experience in handling broken car glass
replacement and windshield crack repair. We use specialized tools to handle modern car glass
replacement where cars may have advanced driver assistance systems. Such a system requires skilled
windshield glass experts so that all sensors can be reinstalled properly.

## About Windshield Store®

Brief company history

Windshield Store® is ISO 9001:2015 certified automotive glass replacement and windshield repair
service brand. Windshield store®, formerly Auto Glass Masters, is owned by Unified Corporation Pvt
Ltd and operates in Delhi, Gurgaon, Faridabad, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Mumbai.

Windshield Store® operates 10+ service centers at prominent locations in Greater Kailash, Naraina,
Narela, Sector 54 Gurgaon, Sheetla Mata Road, Sector 116 Noida, NIT Faridabad, Badarpur Border,
Jaipur,Udaipur and Saki-Naka Andheri, Mumbai. These stores are supported by customized vans which
help us to offer doorstep replacement of your car windshield.

At Windshield Store® we have a centralized procurement system for car glass, bus glass, adhesives,
and accessories to ensure quality products across all service centers. All glasses are directly
procured from the OEM glass manufacturers or their authorized dealers in the case of luxury car
glasses.

The Windshield Store® prides itself on its quality workmanship, fast and efficient service, and
exceptional customer care. Our team of experienced and certified technicians uses the latest tools
and techniques to ensure that every job is completed to the highest standards.

Windshield Store® is committed to providing its customers with a hassle-free and convenient
experience. We offer doorstep mobile service, where our technicians can come to the customer’s
location to carry out the replacements. We also provide a one-year warranty on all our services,
giving customers the peace of mind they need while driving.

### Repair First Policy

As per our company policy, we don’t believe in replacement as the first option. If the crack in your
car’s front glass is smaller than 3 inches, our team of windshield repair experts would suggest you
go for a repair. In case the crack is not repairable, we have options for windshield replacement.

Windshield Store® employs automotive experts with years of experience in handling broken car glass
replacement and windshield crack repair. We use specialized tools to handle modern car glass
replacement where cars may have advanced driver assistance systems. Such a system requires skilled
windshield glass experts so that all sensors can be reinstalled properly.
